lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five longitudinal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters extending from the mid-flank to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like appearance on the mid-to-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges on the upper flank characterized by a light-to-dark vertical pixel gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots visible primarily on the posterior half of the first dorsal fin.
